rules.title: Tenants Rights and Resources Ordinance (Chapter 8.71, Cambridge Municipal Code)
rules.requirement: Owners, landlords and management companies must give tenants a city Guide on housing rights and resources at the start of a tenancy and when legal steps to terminate it are taken (e.g., Notice to Quit or Summary Process). It does not bar evictions otherwise allowed by law.
rules.key_value: Guide provided at tenancy start and at termination; fine of $300 per day of violation
rules.penalty: Fine of $300 for each day's violation (Sec. 8.71.070)
rules.citation: Chapter 8.71 of the Cambridge Municipal Code
rules.status_basis: Described as an existing ordinance in the Cambridge Municipal Code; adoption and effective dates not stated.

exempt_if.name: health_or_treatment_facility
exempt_if.text: rental units in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility or in a non-profit facility that has the primary purpose of providing short term assistance, treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug or other substance abuse

exempt_if.name: short_term_rental_units
exempt_if.text: Short Term Rental Units as set forth in Article 4, Section 4.60 of the Cambridge Zoning Ordinance

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental agreements, including a single residential dwelling unit and tenants at will.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Does not apply to hospital, skilled nursing or health facility units, non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities, or short term rental units.

rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance also requires that a landlord provide the Guide to tenants when legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken (ex. Notice to Quit or Summary Process).
